title: Bus breakdown on the Pennsylvania road
summary: The band's bus broke down on a two-lane road in winter.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: If you had to do over again, what would you change?

Well, one time I was on a tour before the turnpike was completed, like the Pennsylvania Turnpike, and we had to go from New York to Pittsburgh. I think that's one of the things I would change. Me riding in that bus with the whole band and it's this time of year. And, the bus broke down. And we had those two lanes, and we couldn't get help.
And, here we are freezing. Not freezing. We was, you know, actually cold. We had to get out of the bus and get on the side of the road and make a fire. You know, (inaudible).

That's one thing in my mind that I remember that I hope I won't have to go through again cause that was a really shocking thing. Although, it was a good thing that we was that young. That's about the only way we could have taken then, those years.
You mean actual, on the road?

On the road cause, you know, this was a night, and nobody was coming down, and the bus broke down. We had to wait there. I don't know what month, but it was this time of year. And that was a really, really one tough evening just waiting on the bus.
